cover.caption: Dama trengte en gjeter.
cover.alt: Dama lener seg på grinda med telefonen i hånda og ser på tre menn som vil bli gjeter: en svær fyr i skitne arbeidsklær, en mager kar med gule øyne og en mann med rødt skjegg.
cover.prompt: At the wooden gate of her smallholding on a clear late-August morning, the Farmer leans on the gate with her phone in her hand, sizing up three men who want the herdsman job, standing in a row on the gravel track: the Big Guy grinning in his filthy overalls, the Thin Man staring at her with his pale yellow eyes as if weighing her in kilos, and the Red-Bearded Man with his hands folded, smiling just nicely enough. Three goats and two sheep peer through the fence behind her.

Create the cover illustration for an illustrated book of modern fairy tales, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: At the wooden gate of her smallholding on a clear late-August morning, the Farmer leans on the gate with her phone in her hand, sizing up three men who want the herdsman job, standing in a row on the gravel track: the Big Guy grinning in his filthy overalls, the Thin Man staring at her with his pale yellow eyes as if weighing her in kilos, and the Red-Bearded Man with his hands folded, smiling just nicely enough. Three goats and two sheep peer through the fence behind her.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Farmer: A strong, broad-shouldered woman of about forty with a wide, wind-tanned face, a broad nose, sharp blue eyes under heavy black brows and a firm, no-nonsense mouth; her black hair is tucked under a dark-red bandana knotted at the nape. She wears a dark-green fleece jacket over a blue-and-white checked flannel shirt, jeans with a wide leather belt and black muck boots.
- the Big Guy: A huge man as broad as a barn door, with a wide round face, small kind brown eyes, a shiny round nose, a tuft of honey-blond hair sticking up on top of his head and a thick honey-blond beard that grows right up to his eyes. He wears filthy brown canvas work overalls over a cream thermal top, and enormous muddy work boots.
- the Thin Man: A lanky, long-legged man with a long, narrow face, pale yellow eyes, shaggy smoke-grey hair, darker on top and silver at the temples, large ears with the tip of the left one folded over, and a polite, awkward, closed-mouth smile. He wears a thin, worn grey jacket far too light for the weather, grey jeans and scuffed grey trainers.
- the Red-Bearded Man: A slim, wiry man of about thirty-five with a narrow, foxy face, a pointed nose, large honey-brown eyes, a neat, short copper-red beard, copper-red hair, quick hands and a smile that is just nice enough. He wears a green waxed jacket over a cream jumper, brown trousers and brown boots, with a small brown leather bag across his chest.

Story world: Present-day Norway in late August. Dama has a smallholding at the far end of a valley: a white farmhouse with a red barn, a gravel yard with a wooden gate, and a tractor track down to a river and a birch grove, with twelve goats, twenty sheep and three cows. She works full-time at the health centre. Down in the village are a small petrol station with pumps under a canopy and a little grocery shop with a bench outside and a bottle-return machine inside the door. The three men who want the herdsman job are really a bear, a wolf and a fox in human shape, with only small hints: the big one's fur-like beard, the thin one's yellow eyes, and the red-bearded one's bushy tail, hidden under his jacket until the very end.

This story's season, light and colours: Late August in a green valley: the first yellow birch leaves, golden stubble fields, blue ridges and clear, cool days, with flat grey daylight at the petrol station. The last scene is a dark night, lit by warm kitchen light spilling from an open door onto the gravel.

Present-day Norway: fjord towns, suburbs, farms with tractors, cabins, ferries, roadside petrol stations, offices and flats, grey rain and bright snow, with people in modern clothes such as rain jackets, knitted sweaters, hoodies, suits and work wear. The magic of the tale appears plainly in this everyday world: trolls, talking animals and enchantments look real and slightly absurd, drawn in the same flat style. illustrations.anchor: Den traff helt ytterst på halen.
illustrations.caption: Den traff helt ytterst på halen. Hun hadde aldri lagt merke til at han hadde hale.
illustrations.alt: Mannen med rødt skjegg spretter ut på gårdsplassen i mørket, og under jakka stikker en rødgul revehale fram. Dama slenger fløteskvetten etter ham, og den treffer helt ytterst på halen.
illustrations.prompt: Night in the farmyard, lit only by warm light spilling from the open kitchen door of the white farmhouse. The Red-Bearded Man leaps away across the gravel with cream in his beard, and from under his green jacket sticks out a bushy golden-orange fox's tail with a black end. In the doorway the Farmer has just flung the last splash of cream from a jug, and the white splash lands right on the very tip of his tail. Her mouth falls open in astonishment.
